name: Counter-intuitive
pattern: Everyone gets this wrong - here's what actually happens

name: Hidden reason
pattern: The hidden reason behind something familiar

name: Stakes / countdown
pattern: You have N seconds/minutes - what do you do?

name: Cast lives through it
pattern: One of our characters lives through the event or situation

name: Then vs now
pattern: How it was vs how it is now

name: Mystery to solve
pattern: A puzzle the viewer solves alongside the cast

name: Where we disagree
pattern: State the common belief, then where we disagree and why - grounded and fact-checked, never contrarian for its own sake

name: Redefine it
pattern: Reframe what the thing really is (e.g. 'constraints don't make you creative, they make you decisive')

name: Tell your younger self
pattern: How a cast member would explain this to their younger self

name: Why it matters to you
pattern: Why the everyday viewer should care, in their own life, today
